#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

using ll = long long;
ll mod_inv(ll a, ll m) {
	assert(m > 0);
	if (m == 1) return 0;
	a %= m;
	if (a < 0) a += m;
	assert(a != 0);
	if (a == 1) return 1;
	return m - mod_inv(m, a) * m / a;
}

template <int MOD_> struct ModNum {
	int val;
	static const int MOD = MOD_;

	ModNum() : val(0) {}
	ModNum(ll v_) : val(int(v_ % MOD)) { if (val < 0) val += MOD; }
	explicit operator int() const { return val; }
	friend bool operator == (const ModNum& a, const ModNum& b) { return a.val == b.val; }
	friend bool operator != (const ModNum& a, const ModNum& b) { return a.val != b.val; }

	ModNum operator ~ () const {
		ModNum res;
		res.val = mod_inv(val, MOD);
		return res;
	}

	ModNum& operator += (const ModNum& o) {
		val += o.val;
		if (val >= MOD) val -= MOD;
		return *this;
	}
	ModNum& operator -= (const ModNum& o) {
		val -= o.val;
		if (val < 0) val += MOD;
		return *this;
	}
	ModNum& operator *= (const ModNum& o) {
		val = int(ll(val) * ll(o.val) % MOD);
		return *this;
	}
	ModNum& operator /= (const ModNum& o) {
		return *this *= (~o);
	}

	friend ModNum operator + (const ModNum& a, const ModNum& b) { return ModNum(a) += b; }
	friend ModNum operator - (const ModNum& a, const ModNum& b) { return ModNum(a) -= b; }
	friend ModNum operator * (const ModNum& a, const ModNum& b) { return ModNum(a) *= b; }
	friend ModNum operator / (const ModNum& a, const ModNum& b) { return ModNum(a) /= b; }
};

using num = ModNum<int(1e9) + 7>;

int main() {
	ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
	cin.tie(nullptr);
	cout.tie(nullptr);

	const int N = 6;
	vector<vector<num>> prob(N, vector<num>(N, 0));
	int read_n;
	cin >> read_n;
	for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) prob[i][i] = 1;
	for (int i = 0; i < read_n; i++) {
		for (int j = 0; j < read_n; j++) {
			int a;
			cin >> a;
			prob[i][j] = num(a) / num(100);
		}
	}

	const int F = 20;
	vector<vector<num>> dp(2, vector<num>(1 << F, 0));
	vector<vector<int>> msk(2);
	for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
		for (int j = 0; j < i; j++) {
			for (int k = 0; k < j; k++) {
				msk[0].push_back((1 << i) ^ (1 << j) ^ (1 << k));
				msk[1].push_back(((1 << N) - 1) ^ msk[0].back());
			}
		}
	}
	assert(F == (int)msk[0].size());

	for (int t = 0; t < 2; t++) {
		for (int e = 0; e < (1 << (N / 2 * N)); e++) {
			num pval = 1;
			int edges[N / 2];
			for (int i = 0; i < N / 2; i++) edges[i] = 0;
			for (int i = 0; i < N / 2 * N; i++) {
				bool bit = (e >> i) & 1;
				num pp = prob[(i / N) * 2 + t][i % N];
				pval *= bit ? pp : (1 - pp);
				edges[i / N] |= int(bit) << (i % N);
			}
			int wmask = 0;
			for (int a = 0; a < (int)msk[t].size(); a++) {
				int mask = msk[t][a];
				int r[N / 2];
				for (int i = 0; i < N / 2; i++) r[i] = edges[i] & mask;
				if (r[0] && r[1] && r[2]) {
					if (__builtin_popcount(r[0] | r[1] | r[2]) == 3) {
						int x = __builtin_popcount(r[0] | r[1]);
						int y = __builtin_popcount(r[0] | r[2]);
						int z = __builtin_popcount(r[1] | r[2]);
						if (x >= 2 && y >= 2 && z >= 2) {
							wmask |= (1 << a);
						}
					}
				}
			}
			dp[t][wmask] += pval;
		}
	}

	for (int i = 0; i < F; i++) {
		for (int j = 0; j < (1 << F); j++) {
			if ((j >> i) & 1) continue;
			dp[0][j ^ (1 << i)] += dp[0][j];
		}
	}

	num ans = 0;
	for (int j = 0; j < (1 << F); j++) {
		ans += dp[0][j] * dp[1][((1 << F) - 1) ^ j];
	}
	ans = 1 - ans;
	cout << (int)ans << '\n';
	return 0;
